headline: Email drafts and general project questions now draw on the same trust-gated project memory as your preps and project loads — steadier context everywhere, nothing to do on your side.

items.prompt_template: The memory layer now reaches everything. Email drafts and loose project questions ("pull up Northstar", "where are we with the pilot") draw on the same canonical, trust-gated read of each project's history that meeting preps and project loads adopted in the last update. Projects with a well-bound record get steadier, richer context; thin-history projects answer plainly instead of guessing. Nothing to do — it applies from your next draft or question.
